text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day as I'm walking around the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm Fine Motion and thank you for
coming! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Phew!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh? That was rather refined. Practicing
for your
concert, I take it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Groove! Perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying out different things to make
the crowd
go wild.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm about to start over. Do you mind
watching
me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Seems like you're quite serious, so sure.
Show me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Okay. Ahem...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hey there! Pull uppa seat!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone! It's the moment
you've been
waiting for! Give it up for
Fine Motion!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You know what's a "fine" deal? The fried
rice set!
Enjoy a noodle refill on the
house!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's me, everyone! Thanks for coming
out!
What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I have so many questions. First, what was that speech?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you picked up on the trick? I knew
nothing
would get past you! Every
performance needs a
hook, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And I thought to myself: who better to
reference
than ramen shop owners,
calling out to
passersby?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
They always catch my attention, so the

technique's sure to stop people in their
tracks!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I have to ask. You're not just messing
with me,
are you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No way! My goal is to make all my fans
super
excited! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Then why the act? You don't have to be
eccentric
to make them happy.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's exactly the kind of tip I need!
I'm not
used to gathering people's
attention myself.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I have experience receiving guests, but that's not quite the same as inviting them, is it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can improve my acting with
your
advice! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I get that you're trying your best, so
let me see
it one more time. I'll give you
an honest critique.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Thank you! Before I jump in, can I
ask one
thing first?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Do you think they'd prefer a free portion
size
upgrade over a free noodle refill?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Neither! Get your mind off ramen and
focus on
the performance!
